title: The kids on the ramp
logline: Gully's two on the ramp in May: the girl, fourteen, sitting; the boy, eleven, sliding down it on cardboard; the pup at the bottom. Built for a dog; used by everyone. Gully's boots at the top.

panels.composition: A plank ramp at a shingle shack's door with a fourteen-year-old girl sitting on its edge and a boy of eleven sliding down it on flattened cardboard, a small three-legged dog at the bottom, a stocky man's boots at the top.
